appended.mechanism_name: Perform an internal, non-excavation retrofit of pre-1980 valve chambers: apply preformed removable insulation jackets/sh
appended.what_was_proposed: District heating network heat loss can be quantified as a function of network geometry, implying that localized heat-loss contributions (such as from uninsulated valve chambers) can be evaluated and targeted by geometry-specific retrofit measures rather than wholesale network reconstruction.
